snippet.title: PURE ROGUE-JUTSU FLOW | Tenjutsu Gameplay Trailer | Coming 2027 to PC and Switch 2
snippet.description:
Step into the shoes of a renegade yakuza hellbent on defying her former associates in this fast and fluid rogue-jutsu from Sébastien Benard, the designer of Dead Cells.

Tenjutsu launches in 2027 on PC and Nintendo Switch 2.
